body:
**Should fix (correctness): Salvage fails when the user confirms overwriting an existing file**

`moveFile` uses `COPYFILE_EXCL`, and `salvage` passes it the path from `showSaveDialog`. The native dialog already asks the user to confirm an overwrite. If they pick an existing file and confirm, `rename` may fail (e.g. EXDEV) and the copy then fails with EEXIST. `salvage` throws, `offerSaveElsewhere` returns null, and the user sees the 'kept, will recover on next launch' toast even though they chose a destination. Salvage should allow overwrite, for example with an option on `moveFile`. Only the vault and sweep paths need EXCL. Note also that `rename` overwrites on POSIX while the copy path does not, so behaviour differs by volume.

**Note (other): Recovered title is a hard-coded English string**

"Recovered recording" is persisted in the sidecar and shown in the Library. The rest of the change localizes its user-facing strings (en/es). Consider an i18n key, or a title that is a stable sentinel the UI translates at render time.

**Note (other): Sweep of os.tmpdir() relies on an mtime heuristic**

The sweep adopts every `kaipu-rec-*.mp4.part` in the shared system temp dir older than 2 minutes. A long-paused recording by another running instance, or a writer that does not touch the file for more than 2 minutes, would be moved out from under it. Check whether single-instance locking makes this impossible. Otherwise, prefer a stronger signal than mtime.

**Note (other): No feature doc or backlog entry**

CLAUDE.md requires every new feature to have a doc under `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/` (a `backlog/` page plus a row in `backlog/index.mdx`). This PR adds stranded-recording recovery and a save-elsewhere flow but no doc.

Fixed in 240be755: moveFile takes an overwrite option, used only by salvage (the save dialog already confirmed the replace); vault and sweep moves keep COPYFILE_EXCL. Covered by recording-writer.salvage-overwrite.test.ts, which failed with EEXIST before the change.

Fixed in 48028233: the sweep now takes the title from the main-process translator (createMainTranslator, as the dialogs do) via the new library.recoveredRecordingTitle key in en and es, passed in from index.ts.

No code change. The sweep runs once, in app.whenReady behind the hasSingleInstanceLock guard (src/main/index.ts:130, 537, 832), before any recording can start in this process, and the lock stops a second copy with the same userData. The residual case is a dev build and a packaged build (different userData, different locks) with an unavailable vault, so a take sits in os.tmpdir() and is paused over 2 minutes; I noted it under Limits in the new backlog doc.
Fixed in 740b8915: added backlog/recording-finalize-recovery.md (status 🟢, behaviour, manual validation steps), a row in backlog/index.mdx and the sidebar entry in astro.config.mjs.
